blocks.text: Designing for accessibility involves making digital content usable for all individuals, including those with disabilities:

items: Readable Fonts: Use clear and large fonts that are easy to read.
Example: Choose fonts like Arial or Times New Roman and avoid overly decorative styles.
Alternative Text for Images: Provide descriptions for images so that visually impaired users can understand the content.
Example: Include descriptive text for charts or graphs in a report.
